name: Torve Sources
description: Choose the extensions you want. Configure providers at their own websites and add the personal manifest URL they supply. Nothing installs automatically.

extensions.name: Panda
extensions.description: Configure playback providers, debrid and Usenet at Panda, then add the personal manifest URL it supplies. The public manifest is a setup entry point.

extensions.name: Torrentio
extensions.description: Configure supported playback providers at Torrentio, then add its configured manifest URL. Source compatibility depends on the provider and playback URL returned.

extensions.name: Cinemeta
extensions.description: Movie and series catalogues and metadata.

extensions.name: The Movie Database Addon
extensions.description: TMDB catalogues and metadata, with optional provider configuration.

extensions.name: Trakt Tv
extensions.description: The base manifest supplies metadata. Configure with the provider to add your chosen Trakt catalogue lists.

extensions.name: IMDB Catalogs
extensions.description: Movie and series catalogue lists, configurable at the provider.

extensions.name: RPDB Catalogs
extensions.description: Catalogue lists with rating posters. Provider configuration is required before installing its personal manifest URL.

extensions.name: OpenSubtitles v3
extensions.description: Subtitle lookup for movies and series.
